blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Current 3D scene understanding pipelines typically concatenate vast numbers of 3D object tokens with text tokens and feed the resulting sequence to a Large Language Model (LLM). However, existing 3D-LLMs for scene understanding encounter two major limitations: (i) excessive inclusion of task-irrelevant object data, introducing noise that reduces reasoning accuracy and increases hallucinations; and (ii) reliance solely on point cloud data, which inherently lacks the rich semantic information available in complementary 2D modalities, such as color, material properties, texture, and high-level contextual relationships. To address these challenges, we introduce 3D-SceneQ, a 3D LLM that unifies adaptive token pruning with multimodal semantic enrichment, markedly advancing scene understanding, reasoning, and grounding. Specifically, we propose a Query-Guided Adaptive Pruning (QGAP) module that adaptively selects task-relevant objects based on the intended meaning of user instructions, leveraging a learnable latent query to retain critical information while effectively suppressing irrelevant noise. In addition, we introduce a Multi-modal Object-level Feature Enhancement (MOFE) module, which integrates 2D feature embeddings from pre-trained models into 3D representation to enrich object-level semantic information. Evaluations show that 3D-SceneQ outperforms current state-of-the-art methods across multiple benchmarks (e.g., +5.7 CIDEr on Scan2Cap and +17.0 EM@1 on SQA3D), demonstrating its remarkable capabilities in various 3D language reasoning tasks.
blocks.zh: 当前3D场景理解管路一般会将大量3D对象符号与文本符号相接并反馈到一个大语言模型(LLM)上. 然而,现有的用于场景理解的3D-LLM遭遇了两大限制:(一)过多地收录了与任务无关的对象数据,引入了降低推理精度并增加幻觉的噪声;和(二)完全依赖点云数据,而点云数据本身缺乏在互补的2D模式中可以获得的丰富的语义信息,如颜色,物质属性,纹理等高层次上下文关系. 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了3D-SceneQ(3D-SceneQ),这是一种3D LLM,它统一了适应性标志,使多模式语义丰富,显著地推进了场景理解,推理和地平线. 具体地说,我们提议一个查询- Guided Adaptive Pruning(QGAP)模块,根据用户指令的预期含义,适应性地选择与任务相关的对象,利用可学习的潜在查询保留关键信息,同时有效抑制无关的噪音. 此外,我们引入了多模式对象级地物增强(MOFE)模块,该模块将2D特性从预先训练过的模型嵌入到3D表达中来丰富对象级语义信息. 评价显示,3D-SceneQ超越了目前跨越多条基准的先进方法(例如:Scan2Cap上的+5.7 CIDER和SQA3D上的+17.0 EM@1),显示出其在各种3D语言推理任务的卓越能力.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Understanding 3D visual information is fundamental to numerous emerging technological domains, including autonomous navigation [ 1 ] , augmented and virtual reality [ 2 ] , robotics [ 3 ] , and intelligent manufacturing systems [ 4 ] .
Effective interpretation of spatial structures and object relationships within 3D environments significantly enhances the capability of artificial intelligence (AI) systems to perceive, understand, and interact with the physical world.
In recent years, considerable progress has been made in Large Language Models (LLMs), extending their applications from traditional natural language processing to advanced multimodal tasks, including complex 3D scene understanding [ 5 , 6 ] .
Building upon these advancements, recent LLMs have demonstrated strong potential in 3D-related tasks. By integrating and analyzing rich spatial point cloud data, LLMs have demonstrated strong potential in a range of 3D-related tasks such as precise scene interpretation [ 7 ] , robust object perception [ 8 ] , and advanced spatial reasoning [ 9 ] .
Such capabilities substantially enhance the contextual awareness and environmental comprehension of AI systems, ensuring more reliable and efficient performance in real-world applications. Therefore, continued exploration and development in this interdisciplinary field promise to foster deeper and more meaningful interactions among humans, machines, and complex physical environments.
blocks.zh:
理解3D视觉信息对众多新兴技术领域至关重要,包括自主导航[1],增强和虚拟现实[2],机器人[3],以及智能制造系统. [4].
对3D环境中的空间结构和物体关系的有效解释,大大提高了人工智能系统感知,理解和与物理世界互动的能力.
近年来,大语言模型(LLMs)取得了相当大的进展,将其应用从传统的自然语言处理扩展到先进的多式联运任务,包括复杂的3D场景理解[5,6].
在取得这些进展的基础上,近期的法学硕士课程在与3D有关的任务中展现了巨大潜力。 通过整合和分析丰富的空间点云数据,LLMs在一系列与3D相关的任务中表现出了强大的潜力,如精确的场景判读[7],强对象感知[8],以及先进的空间推理[9].
这种能力大大提高了人工智能系统的背景意识和环境理解,确保了在现实世界应用中更加可靠和高效地发挥作用。 因此,在这个跨学科领域继续探索和发展,有可能促进人类、机器和复杂物理环境之间更深入和更有意义的互动。

blocks.en:
Although these methods have achieved significant advancements, comprehensive 3D scene understanding remains hindered by two major challenges:
(i) Numerous Object Token Noise : current 3D-LLMs [ 10 , 9 ] typically employ 3D encoders (e.g. PointNet [ 11 ] and PointNet++ [ 12 ] ) to convert 3D scenes into a large number of object tokens, among which only a small subset is task-relevant, introducing noise and increasing the likelihood of hallucinations [ 13 ] .
(ii) Missing 2D Semantic Cues : existing models [ 12 , 8 ] for 3D scene understanding primarily rely on point cloud data, which inherently lacks rich semantic cues such as color, material, and high-level contextual relationships, all of which are typically provided by 2D visual features.
However, most contemporary SOTA 3D LLMs, including Leo [ 3 ] and Point-LLM [ 14 ] (see Fig. 1 (a)), ignore these two critical challenges and simply feed the LLM a concatenation of text and 3D object tokens, which limits the model’s ability to reason about spatial semantics and to attain a nuanced understanding of complex 3D scenes.
blocks.zh:
虽然这些方法已取得重大进展,但全面的三维场景理解仍然受到两大挑战的阻碍:
(一)众多对象Token噪声:当前3D-LLMS [10,9] 通常使用3D编码器(如PointNet [11]和PointNet++ [12])将3D场景转换成大量对象符号,其中只有小子集与任务相关,引入噪音并增加幻觉的可能性[13].
(二)缺失的2D语义Cues:用于3D场景理解的现有模型[12,8]主要依赖于点云数据,这些数据本质上缺乏丰富的语义提示,如色彩,材料,以及高层次的上下文关系,这些都通常由2D视觉特征提供.
然而,大多数当代的SOTA 3D LLM,包括Leo [3]和Point-LLM [14](见图1(a)),都忽略了这两个关键的挑战,简单地向LLM提供文本和3D对象符号的调和,这限制了模型对空间语义进行推理的能力,也限制了对复杂3D场景的细微理解.

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we introduce 3D-SceneQ, a novel 3D LLM designed to enhance scene perception, grounding, reasoning, and planning. As illustrated in Fig. 1 (b), 3D-SceneQ comprises two lightweight components: Query-Guided Adaptive Pruning (QGAP) and Multi-modal Object-level Feature Enhancement (MOFE). First , QGAP tackles the challenge of task-relevant object selection by dynamically adjusting the number of objects retained based on the specific requirements of different questions. To achieve this adaptability, QGAP introduces a learnable latent query that adjusts the filtering ratio according to the question’s informational needs. By tailoring object selection to the task, QGAP reduces noise, mitigates hallucinations, and enhances the model’s effectiveness. Second , MOFE addresses the semantic limitations of point cloud data by incorporating 2D semantic features derived from multi-view scene images processed by pre-trained models such as CLIP [ 15 ] . Exploiting the camera intrinsics and extrinsics, MOFE projects multi-view 2D features onto the 3D space, pools the resulting point-wise embeddings into object-level embeddings, and integrates them with 3D tokens through cross-attention to produce a unified multi-modal representation. Through object-level feature fusion, MOFE effectively integrates multi-modal information to enhance the semantic representation of task-relevant objects in 3D LLMs, enabling a richer and more comprehensive understanding of the scene. Unlike traditional multi-view stereo (MVS) methods [ 16 , 17 ] that aim to reconstruct dense 3D geometry, or point-level contrastive approaches such as OpenScene [ 18 ] , MOFE focuses on injecting language-aligned semantic features into object-level 3D representations, enabling deeper multi-modal fusion without relying on geometric reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了3D-SceneQ,一种小说3D LLM,旨在增强场景感知,地面定位,推理和规划. 如图1(b)所示,3D-SceneQ包含两个轻量级组件: Query-Guided 适应性运行(QGAP)和多模式对象级特性增强(MOFE). 首先,QGAP通过根据不同问题的具体要求动态调整保留对象的数量来应对任务相关对象选择的挑战. 为了实现这种适应性,QGAP引入了可学习的潜在查询,根据问题的信息需求调整过滤比率. QGAP通过调整对象选择任务,减少噪音,减轻幻觉,增强模型的效能. 第二,MOFE处理点云数据的语义限制,将从CLIP[15]等预先训练过的模型处理的多景场景图像中衍生出来的2D语义特征纳入其中. MOFE利用相机的内在和外在特性,将多视图2D特性投放到3D空间上,将由此产生的点智嵌入到对象层嵌入中,并通过交叉意向将其与3D符融合,以产生统一的多模式代表. 通过对象级特征聚变,MOFE有效地整合了多模式信息,以加强3D LLM中与任务相关的对象的语义表现,从而能够更丰富和更全面地了解场景. 与旨在重建稠密的3D几何的传统的多视立体(MVS)方法[16,17],或OpenScene[18]等点级对比方法不同,MOFE注重将语言相配合的语义特征注入对象级3D表达,使更深的多模式聚变不依赖于几何重建.

blocks.en:
Beyond their individual strengths, the synergistic integration of QGAP and MOFE gives rise to a virtuous cycle: QGAP filters out redundant clutter, sharpening the model’s focus on task-relevant objects, while MOFE enriches these objects with multi-modal semantics, which in turn reinforces the relevance signals that guide QGAP’s pruning. This synergy enables 3D-SceneQ to achieve a compact yet semantically rich understanding of complex 3D scenes, leading to consistently strong performance across diverse tasks.
We evaluate 3D-SceneQ on a diverse set of 3D benchmarks, including 3D captioning [ 19 ] , 3D question answering [ 20 ] , and situated question answering [ 21 ] .
Comprehensive experimental results show that 3D-SceneQ achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across all these tasks, achieving 78.1 CIDEr on Scan2Cap, 104.7 CIDEr on ScanQA, and 67.0 EM@1 on SQA3D, underscoring its strong generalization and reasoning capacity in complex 3D scenes.
The main contributions of this work can be summarized as follows:
blocks.zh:
除了各自的长处外, " QGAP " 和 " MOFE " 的协同结合产生了良性循环: QGAP过滤出冗余的杂音,使模型更关注与任务相关的对象,而MOFE则用多式语义来丰富这些对象,这反过来又强化了指导QGAP穿梭的相关信号. 这种协同作用使3D-SceneQ能够对复杂的3D场景实现紧凑而精密的理解,从而导致不同任务之间持续有力的表现.
我们根据一套不同的3D基准评价3D-场景,包括3D标题[19],3D问题回答[20],定位问题回答[21].
综合实验结果显示,3D-SceneQ在所有这些任务中都实现了最先进的(SOTA)性能,在Scan2Cap上实现了78.1 CIDER,在ScanQA上实现了104.7 CIDER,在SQA3D上实现了67.0 EM@1,强调了它在复杂3D场景中强大的泛化和推理能力.
这项工作的主要贡献可归纳如下:

blocks.en:
• We introduce an innovative 3D-SceneQ to enhance 3D scene understanding and reasoning by reducing task-irrelevant information from 3D encoder and integrating 2D semantic features. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that 3D-SceneQ achieves SOTA performance across diverse 3D understanding tasks. • We propose a Query-Guided Adaptive Pruning (QGAP) module, which dynamically selects task-relevant objects based on a specific user’s question, mitigating hallucinations and improving reasoning accuracy in complex 3D environments by eliminating task-irrelevant tokens. • We develop a Multi-modal Object-level Feature
Enhancement (MOFE) module, which integrates semantically rich 2D features with spatially detailed 3D data to enrich 3D object-level semantic information, enabling deeper scene understanding and robust reasoning.

blocks.en: II Related works
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Point Cloud Understanding
blocks.zh: II-A 点云理解

blocks.en: Understanding 3D scenes is essential for intelligent systems to interact with the physical world. Unlike 2D images, 3D point clouds capture rich spatial and geometric information, making them crucial for tasks such as object recognition, manipulation, and reasoning in applications like robotics and autonomous driving. Early advances in 3D deep learning [ 22 ] were led by architectures such as PointGT [ 23 ] and DTNet [ 24 ] , which laid the foundation for 3D representation learning by effectively processing raw point clouds for classification and segmentation tasks. Meanwhile, inspired by vision-language models like CLIP [ 15 ] , there has been growing interest in aligning 3D point clouds with language. Methods such as PointCLIP [ 25 ] and CLIP2Point [ 26 ] project point clouds into 2D depth images for zero-shot classification using 2D CLIP models. Later works like ULIP [ 27 ] and OpenShape [ 28 ] employ contrastive learning to align 3D encoders with image and text through point-image-text triplets, improving the transferability of 3D representations. Unfortunately, these methods are inherently constrained to object-level tasks and struggle to generalize to scene-level understanding.
blocks.zh: 理解3D场景对于智能系统与物理世界互动至关重要. 与2D图像不同,3D点云捕捉到丰富的空间和几何信息,使其对于机器人和自主驱动等应用中的对象识别,操纵,推理等任务至关重要. 3D深层学习的早期进展[22]是由PointGT[23]和DTNet[24]等架构牵头的,通过有效处理原始点云进行分类和分化任务,为3D表达学习奠定了基础. 同时,受CLIP[15]等视觉语言模型的启发,人们越来越关注将3D点云与语言对齐. 方法如PointCLIP[25]和CLIP2Point[26]项目点云为2D深度图像,用于使用2D CLIP模型进行零射线分类. 后来的作品如ULIP[27]和OpenShape[28]采用对比式学习,通过点-图像-文本三进制使3D编码器与图像和文本对齐,提高了3D表达式的可转移性. 不幸的是,这些方法在本质上受到对象级任务的制约,并努力将一般化到场景级的理解.

blocks.en: Recently, there has been growing interest in combining 3D point clouds with natural language to enable tasks [ 29 , 10 , 30 , 19 , 31 ] . 3D Question Answering [ 29 ] which focuses on answering questions grounded in 3D scenes, 3D Visual Grounding [ 30 , 32 ] which evaluates object localization from text and 3D captioning [ 19 ] further tests a model’s ability to describe 3D scenes in natural language. However, most existing methods are designed for specific tasks and struggle to generalize beyond the distribution of their training data. In contrast, recent 3D Multi-modal Large Language Models (3D-LLMs) unify diverse 3D-language tasks within a single architecture, leveraging LLMs’ reasoning abilities to handle QA, grounding, captioning, and more complex tasks like 3D dialogue and task decomposition.
blocks.zh: 最近,人们越来越有兴趣将3D点云与自然语言结合起来,以便实现任务[29,10,30,19,31]. 3D问题回答 [29] 专注于回答基于3D场景的问题,3D视觉定位 [30,32] 从文本和3D字幕中评价对象本地化 [19] 进一步测试模型用自然语言描述3D场景的能力. 然而,大多数现有方法都是为具体的任务而设计的,并努力在培训数据的分配之外加以概括。 相比之下,最近的3D多式大语言模型(3D-LLMs)将不同的3D语言任务统一在一个单一架构内,利用LLMs的推理能力来处理QA,定位,字幕,以及3D对话和任务解析等更复杂的任务.

blocks.en: II-B Multi-Modal Large Language Models
blocks.zh: II-B 多模态 大语言模型

blocks.en: Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are designed to understand and reason across diverse modalities beyond plain text, including images [ 33 , 34 , 15 , 35 ] , video [ 36 , 37 ] , and audio [ 38 ] . These models aim to bridge the gap between language and perception by learning aligned representations across different input modalities. A landmark in this direction is CLIP [ 15 ] , which jointly trains image and text encoders using contrastive learning on large-scale web data, enabling strong zero-shot transfer to downstream tasks. Building upon this, models such as BLIP [ 33 ] and BLIP-2 [ 34 ] adopt a two-stage framework that connects frozen vision encoders with large language models via a learnable query transformer, followed by instruction tuning. LLaVA [ 39 ] further enhances alignment by integrating CLIP visual features with open-source LLMs like Vicuna [ 40 ] , enabling multi-turn visual conversation and reasoning. More recent works, including Flamingo [ 35 ] , Shikra [ 41 ] , and MiniGPT-4 [ 42 ] , introduce gated cross-attention mechanisms and lightweight adapters to achieve more efficient and flexible vision-language integration. These models have shown strong performance across a variety of tasks such as visual question answering, image captioning, and multimodal instruction following, demonstrating the growing potential of MLLMs as general-purpose reasoning engines across modalities.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大语言模型的设计旨在理解和解释超出纯文本的各种模式,包括图像[33、34、15、35]、视频[36、37]和音频[38]。 这些模式旨在通过学习不同投入模式的一致表述,弥合语言与认知之间的差距。 这个方向上的一个里程碑是CLIP [15],它联合训练图像和文本编码器,在大规模网络数据上使用对比性学习,使强大的零镜头传输到下游任务. 在此基础上,BLIP[33]和BLIP-2[34]等模型采用两阶段框架,通过可学习的查询变换器将冷冻的视觉编码器与大型语言模型连接起来,然后进行指令调试. LLaVA[39]通过将CLIP的视觉功能与维库纳等开源LLMs结合[40]进一步加强了对齐,使得多回合的视觉对话和推理成为可能. 更近期的作品包括Flamingo [35],Shikra [41],以及MiniGPT-4 [42],引入了有门的交叉注意机制和轻量级适配器,以实现更有效和更灵活的视觉语言融合. 这些模型在视觉问答、图像字幕和随后的多式联运指令等各种任务中表现出强有力的性能,表明MLLMs作为通用推理引擎在各种模式中的潜力越来越大。

blocks.en: II-C 3D Multi-Modal Large Language Models
blocks.zh: II-C 3D 多模态 大语言模型

blocks.en: The recent success of multi-modal large language models (LLMs) has spurred growing interest in extending their capabilities to the 3D domain [ 10 , 43 , 7 , 14 , 8 , 44 , 45 , 46 , 3 , 47 , 48 ] . Among these efforts, 3D-LLM [ 10 ] introduces 3D point cloud features into pre-trained 2D vision-language models (VLMs), enabling spatially grounded understanding across diverse 3D-language tasks. SegPoint [ 7 ] adopts a unified architecture that directly feeds point cloud data into LLMs for a wide range of segmentation tasks. Point-LLM [ 14 ] employs a two-stage training approach—first aligning 3D features with the language space, followed by instruction tuning—which facilitates stronger integration between geometric understanding and linguistic reasoning. In contrast, 3D-MiT [ 8 ] proposes a more streamlined framework by eliminating the explicit alignment stage, directly fusing visual features and textual prompts to construct multimodal 3D inputs with reduced training complexity. OneLLM [ 44 ] and Point-Bind LLM [ 45 ] further explore the alignment of 3D point clouds with other modalities—including images, audio, and text—within a shared embedding space, thereby enhancing cross-modal reasoning and enabling seamless interaction between geometric and semantic cues. GPT4Point [ 46 ] extends this direction with a generative multimodal model that supports 3D understanding and controllable output generation. LEO [ 3 ] represents a different line of work, focusing on embodied agents that integrate 3D point clouds and egocentric RGB images for manipulation tasks. However, in LEO, visual inputs are primarily used as low-level control signals, without integrating the high-level semantics of images into a unified 3D representation.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大语言模式(LLMs)最近取得成功,促使人们越来越有兴趣将其能力扩大到3D领域[10、43、7、14、8、44、45、46、3、47、48]。 在这些努力中,3D-LLM[10]将3D点云特征引入了预先训练的2D视觉语言模型(VLM),从而能够在空间基础上理解不同的3D语言任务. SegPoint [7] 采用统一架构,直接将点云数据输入LLMS,用于广泛的分区任务. 点-LLM[14]采用两阶段培训方法——首先将三维特征与语言空间相配合,然后进行教学调试——这有利于几何理解与语言推理之间更紧密的结合。 与此相反,3D-MIT[8]建议通过取消明确的对齐阶段,直接引信视觉特征和文字提示来构建训练复杂程度降低的多式联运3D投入,从而建立一个更精简的框架。 OneLLM [44] 和Point-Bind LLM [45] 进一步探讨在共享嵌入空间内将3D点云与其他模式——包括图像、音频和文本——相配合,从而增强跨模式推理,并促成几何和语义提示之间的无缝互动。 GPT4Point [46] 扩展了这个方向,采用了一种基因多式模型,支持3D理解和可控输出生成. LEO [3] 代表着不同的一行工作,侧重于融合3D点云和以自我为中心的RGB图像用于操纵任务的内在代理. 然而,在LEO中,视觉输入主要作为低级控制信号使用,而没有将图像的高级语义集成到统一的3D表示中.

blocks.en: Despite these advancements, a fundamental challenge remains: point clouds provide rich geometric information but are inherently sparse in semantic content, and often contain significant structural redundancy. Most existing architectures do not explicitly model these characteristics, limiting their ability to fully leverage the expressive potential of 3D representations for downstream reasoning and decision-making tasks.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进步,但一个根本挑战依然存在:点云提供了丰富的几何信息,但语义内容本身就很稀少,而且往往含有显著的结构冗余. 大多数现有架构都没有明确地模拟这些特征,限制了他们充分利用3D表达式的表达潜力来完成下游推理和决策任务的能力.

blocks.en: 3D-SceneQ adopts a two-stage learning scheme to integrate multi-modal information for downstream tasks: (i) 3D Vision-Language Alignment, aligning 3D object features with linguistic representations to form a shared feature space; and (ii) Instruction Tuning, fine-tuning the model with task-specific instructions to improve 3D understanding and reasoning. In the first stage, we employ the object-centric 3D point cloud encoder, PointNet++ [ 12 ] , to interpret the scene. This encoder extracts geometric features for each 3D object and represents them as point cloud embeddings. Spatial Transformer [ 49 ] is then applied after feature extraction to process the point cloud embeddings of all objects, transforming them into object-centric 3D object tokens. Subsequently, these 3D object tokens are projected through a linear layer to align their dimensionality with the requirements of the LLM, producing the final 3D object representation f 3 ​ D ∈ ℝ N × d f_{3D}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times d} , where N N is the number of objects in the scene, and d d is the feature dimensionality compatible with the LLM. The input in this stage includes system messages, user’s questions, and 3D object tokens f 3 ​ D f_{3D} , forming a multi-modal sequence. This sequence is then processed by the pre-trained LLM to generate the final response. Text-based inputs, such as system messages and user’s questions, are tokenized using SentencePiece [ 50 ] with a 32k vocabulary.

Benchmarks. Following [ 3 ] , we utilise a diverse set of 3D vision-language datasets tailored for alignment and instruction tuning. In the 3D vision-language alignment phase, we train the model to bridge the gap between 3D scene representations and natural language using three types of captioning data. These include (i) object-level captions from Cap3D [ 53 ] , which provide fine-grained textual descriptions of objects from Objaverse [ 54 ] ; (ii) object-in-context referring expressions from ScanScribe [ 55 ] and ReferIt3D [ 31 ] , further augmented with LLM-generated annotations to enhance contextual diversity; and (iii) scene-level summaries from 3RScan [ 56 ] , capturing global information about object layouts, spatial relations, and scene semantics.
In the instruction tuning phase, we refine the model’s ability to understand, reason, and respond to natural language instructions in 3D environments. We utilize tasks based on ScanNet [ 57 ] and 3RScan , covering open-ended 3D captioning and question answering, where the model is expected to describe scenes or answer queries about object properties, locations, and relationships.

Evaluation Metrics. We use a set of standard evaluation metrics to assess model performance across various tasks. For language generation tasks, we report CIDEr, BLEU, METEOR, and ROUGE, which measure relevance, fluency, and overlap with reference texts from different perspectives.
In open-ended generation tasks, where multiple correct answers may exist for a given input, we additionally use sentence similarity [ 58 ] to better capture semantic alignment.
For question-answering tasks that require factual precision, we report top-1 exact match accuracy (EM@1), which reflects the proportion of predictions that exactly match the ground truth.

blocks.en: IV-B Comparison with State-of-the-Arts
blocks.zh: 与艺术现状的比较

blocks.en:
We evaluate our method across three prominent 3D scene understanding tasks: 3D scene captioning with Scan2Cap [ 19 ] , 3D question answering (QA) with ScanQA [ 20 ] , and 3D scene-based reasoning with SQA3D [ 21 ] . As summarized in Table III , 3D-SceneQ consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance on all these benchmarks, surpassing strong task-specific baselines as well as fine-tuned specialized models across all evaluation metrics considered.
Specifically, on Scan2Cap it lifts METEOR to 30.5 and ROUGE to 65.3, exceeding the previous best by 2.6 and 7.2 points, respectively; on ScanQA it pushes CIDEr to 104.7 and BLEU-4 to 13.6, reflecting more relevant and fluent answers; and on the SQA3D test set it attains an EM@1 of 67.0%, a striking 17 point leap over the strongest prior method, demonstrating exceptional proficiency in generating precise and contextually informative outputs.
In contrast to conventional methods that depend on carefully engineered task-specific architectures, 3D-SceneQ adopts a unified LLM-based framework augmented with lightweight components—QGAP and MOFE. This unified architecture allows the model to flexibly and effectively adapt to diverse 3D reasoning tasks, enabling robust open-ended response generation while maintaining highly competitive quantitative performance achieved by specialized methods.
blocks.zh:
我们评价我们的方法跨越三个突出的3D场景理解任务:3D场景字幕用Scan2Cap [19],3D问答(QA)用ScanQA [20],3D场景推理用SQA3D [21]. 如表三所概述,3D-SceneQ在所有这些基准上始终取得最先进的业绩,超过了针对具体任务的强有力的基线,并对所有评价指标进行了微调。
具体地说,在Scan2Cap上,METEOR升至30.5,ROUGE升至65.3,分别比之前的最好成绩高2.6和7.2分;在ScanQA上,它将CIDER推至104.7,BLEU-4升至13.6,反映了更相关和更流畅的答案;在SQA3D测试上,它达到67.0%的EM@1,这是比最强的先前方法的惊人的17点跃升,显示出在产生准确和上下文信息产出方面的超强能力。
与依赖于精心设计的任务特定架构的常规方法相反,3D-SceneQ采用了一个基于LLM的统一框架,增加了轻量级组件QQGAP和MOFE. 这种统一的架构使得模型能够灵活有效地适应不同的3D推理任务,使得能够产生强大的开放式响应,同时保持通过专门方法实现的高度竞争性量化性能.

blocks.en: IV-C Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: IV-C 阅读研究

blocks.en: IV-C 1 Effectiveness of Core Components
blocks.zh: 核心部分的有效性

blocks.en:
We conducted ablation studies in Table IV to disentangle the individual and combined effects of 3D-SceneQ’s two core modules: Query-Guided Adaptive Pruning (QGAP) and the Multi-modal Object-Feature Enhancer (MOFE). Using the LEO [ 3 ] architecture with embodied agent related components removed as the Baseline model, we draw four nuanced observations: First, random pruning helps reduce redundancy but risks discarding crucial cues. The RandFilter variant stochastically discards 40% of object tokens whenever a scene contains more than 20 objects. This naïve compression alone propels SQA3D EM@1 from 50.0 to 68.9 by reducing extraneous information evidence that minimizing redundant information helps the model reason more effectively. Yet the indiscriminate pruning also removes salient objects and attributes, collapsing Scan2Cap CIDEr from 72.4 to 52.3 and diminishing ScanQA performance as well. The result exposes a core tension: token economy is vital, but pruning must be relevance-aware. Second, QGAP enhances both descriptive quality and reasoning accuracy. QGAP learns a filtering ratio over object tokens conditioned on the user’s question, excising only those entities that contribute negligibly to the downstream objective. This targeted sparsification raises Scan2Cap CIDEr to 78.4 and SQA3D EM@1 to 70.1, outperforming both the Baseline and RandFilter. The gains affirm that relevance-aware pruning preserves key geometric and semantic cues while still reaping the efficiency benefits of a lighter context. Third, MOFE boosts holistic performance, especially on ScanQA. By fusing geometric, visual, and linguistic signals into a refined object embedding, MOFE elevates Scan2Cap CIDEr to 77.8 and boosts SQA3D EM@1 to 66.7. The improvement on ScanQA is particularly pronounced, suggesting that MOFE’s cross-modal representations equip the model to resolve subtle spatial references and attribute dependencies that commonly confound 3D question answering. Finally, synergistic coupling of QGAP and MOFE yields the most balanced, robust gains. Our full model, 3D-SceneQ, combines QGAP’s task-relevant pruning strategy with MOFE’s semantic enrichment, producing consistent improvements across all benchmarks (e.g., +5.7 CIDEr over Baseline on Scan2Cap, +20.0 EM@1 on SQA3D).
Guided by the user query, QGAP selects task-relevant object tokens. MOFE then enriches these tokens with 2D features and feeds back sharper relevance cues to QGAP. This virtuous loop enables 3D-SceneQ to form a compact yet information-dense representation of complex 3D scenes, yielding balanced gains across diverse tasks.

blocks.en: IV-C 2 Impact of Filtering Strategies and Ratios in QGAP
blocks.zh: IV-C 2 过滤策略和比率对质量评估方案的影响

blocks.en:
To evaluate the effectiveness of QGAP’s learnable latent query mechanism, we conduct controlled experiments replacing the adaptive pruning module with two fixed-ratio strategies: LowSimFilt, which discards tokens with the lowest BERT-based cosine similarity to the query, and RandFilt, which randomly removes tokens. We vary the pruning ratio from 10% to 50% in 10% increments and report results in Table V and Table VI .
As shown in both tables, all fixed-ratio pruning strategies result in consistent and monotonic degradation in performance as the pruning ratio increases. This suggests that static heuristics are inherently brittle, as they lack the adaptivity needed to tailor pruning decisions to different query demands: over-pruning risks eliminating crucial context, while under-pruning retains distracting or irrelevant tokens.
In contrast, QGAP adaptively predicts a query-specific pruning ratio via a learnable latent query mechanism. This allows the model to dynamically retain just the right amount of visual context for each question, leading to superior and stable performance across all benchmarks. These results empirically validate the conceptual motivation behind QGAP: different questions require vastly different levels of contextual detail, general scene descriptions need broader visual coverage, while targeted questions require concise yet relevant context, thereby reducing the influence of redundant information. The learnable latent query enables the model to align token retention with the intent and scope of the query, thereby achieving better performance and robustness than any fixed-rule filtering strategies.
blocks.zh:
为了评价QGAP可学习的潜在查询机制的有效性,我们进行了可控实验,用两个固定比例策略来取代适应性穿梭模块:LowSimFilt,它以与查询最低的BERT型余弦相似性丢弃了信号符;RandFilt,它随机去除信号符. 在10%的递增中,我们把挤压率从10%到50%不等,并在表五和表六中报告结果。
如两表所示,随着螺旋桨比例的上升,所有固定倾斜策略都导致性能持续和单质退化。 这表明静态heuristic是内在的脆性,因为它们缺乏根据不同的查询要求调整裁量决定所需的适切性:过度挤压的风险消除了关键的背景,而不足挤压保留了分散注意力或无关紧要的迹象.
相比之下,QGAP通过可学习的潜伏查询机制,适应性地预测了特定查询的浏览比. 这使得模型能够动态地为每个问题保持正确的视觉上下文,从而在所有基准中实现优异和稳定的性能. 这些结果在经验上验证了QGAP背后的概念动机:不同的问题需要大不相同的背景细节,一般场景描述需要更广泛的视觉覆盖,而有针对性的问题则需要简洁而又相关的背景,从而减少冗余信息的影响. 可学习的潜在查询使模型能够使符号保留与查询的意向和范围保持一致,从而比任何固定规则的过滤策略实现更好的性能和稳健性.

blocks.en: IV-C 3 Robustness of MOFE to Sensor Calibration and Registration Errors
blocks.zh: MOFE对传感器校准和登记错误的强性

blocks.en:
MOFE relies on accurate 2D-to-3D feature projection, which depends on intrinsic and extrinsic camera parameters. In real-world scenarios, small calibration or registration errors are inevitable. To assess robustness, we simulate two levels of parameter noise during training:
Mild noise adds Gaussian perturbations (10% probability) to focal length and SE(3) parameters, sampled from 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , ( 0.05 ​ x ) 2 ) \mathcal{N}(0,(0.05x)^{2}) , where x x is the original parameter value. Severe noise increases the probability to 15% and the noise scale to 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , ( 0.10 ​ x ) 2 ) \mathcal{N}(0,(0.10x)^{2}) .
As shown in Table VII , model performance remains strong under both conditions. For example, Scan2Cap CIDEr scores reach 78.0 (mild) and 77.4 (severe), close to the clean setup (77.7). On SQA3D, EM@1 slightly improves (68.7 and 68.1 vs. 66.7). This robustness is attributed to the design of MOFE. Instead of relying on pixel-level precision, MOFE aggregates 2D features across full object masks, making it less sensitive to small spatial misalignments. Minor projection errors caused by pose noise typically affect only a few peripheral pixels, which are averaged out during object-level pooling. Furthermore, the public datasets used for evaluation, such as ScanNet and 3RScan, offer highly accurate camera poses, with real-world deviations far smaller than our simulated noise. These results demonstrate that 3D-SceneQ is robust to moderate calibration errors, and MOFE remains effective under realistic conditions.

blocks.en: IV-C 4 Influence of Training Setups
blocks.zh: 培训机制的影响

blocks.en: We analyze the impact of different training setups on 3D-SceneQ performance in Table VIII , including variants trained without alignment ( w/o Align ) and models trained exclusively on ScanNet ( ScanNet-only ) or 3RScan ( 3RScan-only ). The ScanNet-only variant slightly underperforms compared to the full 3D-SceneQ model even on ScanNet tasks and notably struggles with cross-domain tasks (3RQA, 3RDialog, 3RPlan). Similarly, 3RScan-only achieves strong performance on 3RScan tasks but shows limited zero-shot generalization capability on ScanNet tasks. These results underscore the benefits of joint training, which offers broader coverage across diverse scenes and tasks and thereby leads to superior overall performance and enhanced cross-domain generalization in 3D-SceneQ.
blocks.zh: 我们分析表八中不同培训设置对3D-SceneQ性能的影响,包括未经对齐(w/o Align)训练的变体和专门在ScanNet(ScanNet-只)或3RScan(3RScan-只)训练的模型. ScanNet独占的变体与完整的3D-SceneQ模型相比,甚至对于ScanNet的任务,以及显著的与跨域任务(3RQA,3Rdialog,3RPlan)的争斗都稍有不足. 同样,只3RScan在3RScan任务上实现了强性能,但在ScanNet任务上显示出有限的零射一般化能力. 这些成果凸显了联合培训的好处,这种培训在各种场景和任务中提供更广泛的覆盖面,从而导致总体表现更好,并在3D-SceneQ中加强跨领域通用.

blocks.en: IV-D Visual Analysis
blocks.zh: IV-D 视觉分析

blocks.en: In Fig. 5 , we evaluate the performance of 3D-SceneQ against the baseline method across two aspects of 3D scene understanding. First, 3D-SceneQ demonstrates a significant advantage in color perception. By fusing rich appearance cues extracted from a large-scale BERT model with the extensive spatial context captured by its 3D backbone, our method can discern subtle chromatic variations that remain unrecognized by the baseline. For example, in Fig. 5 (a), the baseline misclassifies a brown chair as white, whereas 3D-SceneQ correctly identifies its actual color. Similarly, in Fig. 5 (b), 3D-SceneQ accurately identifies the green color of the plants, highlighting its improved understanding of color information compared to the baseline. Second, 3D-SceneQ outperforms the baseline in contextual reasoning. As shown in Fig. 5 (c), 3D-SceneQ suggests putting books and magazines on shelves or on the tabletop, choices that match everyday usage patterns and ergonomic reach. The baseline, by contrast, offers no specific placement at all. This difference is even more pronounced in Fig. 5 (d), where 3D-SceneQ grounds its recommendation in the room’s geometry, selecting the commode because that spot is easy to reach and naturally anchors the room’s visual focus. Although the baseline suggests the same location, it does so in a formulaic way, without any spatial justification, highlighting its lack of scene-aware reasoning.
blocks.zh: 在图5中,我们对照三维场景理解的两个方面的基线方法来评价三维场景的性能. 第一,三维场景 Q在色彩感知方面显示出显著优势. 通过将从大型BERT模型中提取的丰富的外观提示与它的3D主干所捕捉的广泛空间背景相融合,我们的方法可以识别出仍然未被基线识别的微妙的色变. 例如,在图5(a)中,基线错误地将一个棕色椅子归类为白色,而3D-SceneQ则正确识别其实际颜色. 同样,在图5(b)中,3D-场景 Q准确识别植物的绿色,突出其与基线相比对颜色信息的理解有所提高. 第二,三维场景 Q 在背景推理中超过了基线. 如图5(c)所示,3D-SceneQ建议将书籍和杂志放在书架上或桌面上,选择与日常使用模式和人机学影响相符。 相比之下,基线根本没有具体的位置。 在图5(d)中,这种差异更为明显,3D-SceneQ将其推荐依据于房间几何,选择逗号,因为那个位置很容易到达,自然会锁定房间的视觉焦点。 虽然基线表明同一位置,但它以公式方式这样做,没有任何空间理由,突出其缺乏场景感知推理.

Red boxes indicate regions where objects have been pruned by QGAP, distinguishing them from the original scene.

blocks.en:
To evaluate QGAP’s scene-pruning strategy, we conduct a series of experiments and visualize three representative scenarios in Fig. 6 , spanning pruning levels from minimal to aggressive.
In the first example (Fig. 6 (a)), the generic instruction “Tidy up and arrange the room.” does not reference any specific object; consequently, QGAP eliminates only 11% of the object tokens, retaining almost all objects to avoid discarding potentially relevant information.
When the query targets a particular object or category, QGAP applies a more aggressive filter to remove irrelevant elements. For instance, in the second example (Fig. 6 (b)), the query “refrigerator” prompts QGAP to drop unrelated items such as windows and walls, resulting in a filtering ratio of 18%. In the third example (Fig. 6 (c)), the query “furnishings” leads to the removal of objects like plants and pillows, raising the ratio to 22%.
Overall, these results show that QGAP adaptively modulates its pruning strategy to match the semantic intent of each query, enabling context-aware scene refinement that balances preserving crucial content against excising irrelevant tokens.
blocks.zh:
为了评估QGAP的场景冲刺策略,我们进行了一系列实验,并在图6中可视化出三种有代表性的场景,从最小的冲刺到攻击性。
在第一个例子(图6(a))中,“整理和安排房间”的通用说明没有提及任何特定物体;因此,QGAP只消除11%的物体标志,保留几乎所有物体以避免丢弃可能相关的信息。
当查询针对某个特定对象或类别时,QGAP会使用更积极的过滤器去除不相关的元素. 例如,在第二个例子(图6(b))中,查询“冷藏器”促使QGAP放下与窗户和墙壁等无关的物品,导致过滤率达到18%。 在第三个例子(图6(c))中,查询“家具”导致植物和枕头等物体被清除,将比例提高到22%。
总体而言,这些结果表明,QGAP在适应性上调整了它的推敲策略,以匹配每个查询的语义意图,从而能够改进上下文感知的场景,使保存关键内容与排泄无关的符号保持平衡.

blocks.en: To evaluate 3D-SceneQ’s effectiveness in mitigating hallucinations, we carried out a series of visual analyses (Fig. 6 ). The results indicate that our method markedly reduces hallucinations commonly afflicting 3D LLMs, from which we derive three main observations: First, 3D-SceneQ reduces hallucinations of irrelevant or nonexistent objects. Unlike the baseline, which invents items absent from the scene, such as a “dirty tower” (Fig. 7 (a)), a “cutting board” (Fig. 7 (b)), or a “cooking pot” (Fig. 7 (c)), 3D-SceneQ always remains faithful to the scene content. This robustness stems from the collaborative mechanisms of QGAP and MOFE. When the queried object is absent, QGAP adaptively reduces the pruning ratio, as the similarity between all object-category embeddings in the scene and the question embedding is low, thereby preventing forced matches. Meanwhile, MOFE enriches object understanding with multi-view image features, offering stronger semantic cues. Together, they help 3D-SceneQ recognize invalid queries and respond cautiously instead of hallucinating incorrect answers. Second, 3D-SceneQ substantially mitigates perceptual errors in recognizing object attributes. Hallucinations are not limited to whole objects, they also distort geometry and material. In Fig. 7 (d)–(f) the Baseline warps a square window into a triangle, morphs a round coffee table into a rectangle, and turns wooden cabinets metallic. In contrast, 3D-SceneQ consistently preserves accurate object properties, maintaining robust attribute recognition. Third, 3D-SceneQ excels at distinguishing objects with similar visual features. Objects with similar silhouettes or textures often confound vision-language models. The Baseline mislabels a whiteboard as a bulletin board (Fig. 7 (g)), and a stool as a trash can (Fig. 7 (h)). 3D-SceneQ consistently delivers reliable responses, demonstrating an exceptional ability to distinguish genuine scene elements from hallucinations. Across a wide spectrum of challenging scenes, 3D-SceneQ consistently delivers precise visual perception and contextual reasoning, establishing a new benchmark for 3D scene understanding through its robust and reliable performance.
blocks.zh: 为了评价3D-Scene在缓解幻觉方面的有效性,我们进行了一系列的视觉分析(图6). 结果显示,我们的方法明显减少通常影响3D LLMs的幻觉,我们从中得出三个主要的观察结果:第一,3D-场景 Q减少无关或不存在物体的幻觉. 与基线不同的是,基线发明了现场缺失的物品,如“脏塔”(图7(a))、“切割板”(图7(b))或“煮锅”(图7(c))、3D-场景。 Q始终忠于现场内容. 这种稳健性源于QGAP和MOFE的合作机制. 当被询问对象缺席时,QGAP会因场景中所有对象类嵌入和问题嵌入的相似性较低而适应性地降低穿插比,从而防止强制匹配. 同时,MOFE用多视图图像特性丰富了对象理解,提供了更强的语义提示. 它们共同帮助3D-SceneQ识别无效的询问,并谨慎回答而不是产生幻觉错误的答案. 第二,三维场景 Q大大减轻了识别对象属性的知觉错误. 幻觉不仅限于整个物体,它们也扭曲几何和材料. 在图7(d)-(f)中,基线条形窗为三角形,将圆形咖啡桌变形为矩形,并将木制柜子变成金属。 与之相对的是,3D-SceneQ一致地保留了准确的对象属性,保持了强性属性识别. 第三,三维场景 Q擅长区分具有类似视觉特征的物体. 具有相似的圆形或纹理的物体往往会混淆视觉语言模型. 基线将白板误贴为公告栏(图7(g)),将凳子误贴为垃圾桶(图7(h))。 三维场景 Q始终提供可靠的响应,显示出区分真实场景元素和幻觉的非凡能力. 在众多具有挑战性的场景中,3D-SceneQ始终如一地提供精确的视觉感知和背景推理,通过它的强健可靠的性能,为3D场景理解设定了新的基准.

blocks.en: To evaluate generalization beyond the training domain, we perform zero-shot experiments on the Matterport3D dataset [ 63 ] , a large-scale 3D benchmark containing scenes that 3D-SceneQ has not encountered during training. As it lacks language annotations for captioning or QA, we manually construct a set of prompts to test the model’s ability to understand novel scenes. Fig. 8 (a) and (b) show its ability to identify salient objects, such as correctly detecting the bed at the center, which the baseline misses. In Fig. 8 (c) and (d), it shows clear awareness of material and shape, capturing fine-grained surface and geometry information. Fig. 8 (e) and (f) highlight its robustness in grounding objects in cluttered scenes, successfully locating items like a toilet or coffee table. Finally, Fig. 8 (g) and (h) illustrate accurate color perception, with 3D-SceneQ correctly identifying the blue flooring while the baseline erroneously predicts brown. These results indicate that 3D-SceneQ generalizes well to previously unseen environments, even without fine-tuning, confirming its robustness and broader applicability across domains.
blocks.zh: 为了评价训练领域以外的泛化,我们在Matterport3D数据集上进行零镜头实验[63],这是一个包含3D-SceneQ在训练期间没有遇到的场景的大型3D基准. 由于缺少字幕或QA的语言说明,我们手动构建一套提示来测试模型理解新奇场景的能力. 图8(a)和(b)显示其识别显著物体的能力,如正确探测基线缺失的中央床。 在图8(c)和(d)中,它显示了对材料和形状的明确认识,收集了精细的表面和几何信息。 图8(e)和(f)突出显示其在乱七八糟的场景中安放物体的坚韧性,成功地找到厕所或咖啡桌等物品。 最后,图8(g)和(h)说明了准确的颜色感知,3D-SceneQ正确识别了蓝色地板,而基线则错误地预测了棕色. 这些结果表明,3D-SceneQ即使没有微调,也能很好地概括到以前所未见的环境,从而证实其稳健性和在各个领域的更广泛适用性。

blocks.en: V Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 五、限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: 3D-SceneQ is optimized for indoor scenes and therefore exhibits limited generalization to outdoor settings. Moreover, the absence of explicit temporal modeling reduces robustness in dynamic scenes with moving agents, and its reasoning depth remains constrained without post-training signals. Future work includes adopting more general-purpose encoders and curating balanced indoor–outdoor datasets to narrow the performance gap and strengthen cross-domain generalization. In parallel, the incorporation of post-training signals (e.g., chain-of-thought supervision and reinforcement learning) and the integration of explicit temporal modeling will be explored to enhance reasoning depth and reliability in dynamic scenes.
blocks.zh: 3D-SceneQ为室内场景优化,因此展出仅限于室外设置. 此外,缺乏明确的时间建模降低了动态场景中与感动剂的稳健性,其推理深度仍然受到限制,没有训练后信号. 今后的工作包括采用更通用的编码器,管理平衡的室内 -- -- 室外数据集,以缩小性能差距,加强跨领域通用。 同时,将探索纳入培训后信号(如思维链式监督和强化学习)和明确时间模型的整合,以增强动态场景中的推理深度和可靠性.

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we present 3D-SceneQ, a novel 3D LLM framework designed to advance scene understanding, reasoning, and planning within complex 3D environments. To tackle the challenges of redundant object interference and hallucination issues in 3D LLMs, we introduce QGAP, an adaptive pruning mechanism that selectively eliminates irrelevant object tokens. Additionally, to overcome the semantic limitations inherent in point cloud data, we develop MOFE, a multi-modal feature integration module to overcome the semantic limitations of point cloud data by integrating 2D features to enhance the model’s comprehension of 3D scenes. Extensive experimental evaluations on benchmark tasks, including 3D captioning, question answering, and task planning, consistently demonstrate the superior performance of 3D-SceneQ compared to SOTA approaches. These results highlight the framework’s promising generalization capabilities and enhanced reasoning abilities in challenging 3D environments. Overall, 3D-SceneQ represents a significant advancement in various 3D understanding tasks, offering a strong foundation for future research and applications in intelligent interaction with complex 3D environments.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了3D-SceneQ,一个小说3D LLM框架,旨在在复杂的3D环境中推进场景理解,推理和规划. 为了应对3D LLMs中多余的物体干扰和幻觉问题的挑战,我们引入了QGAP,这是一种适应性的修饰机制,有选择地消除了无关物体符号. 此外,为了克服点云数据固有的语义限制,我们开发了MOFE这个多模式特征集成模块,通过集成2D特征来克服点云数据的语义限制,增强模型对3D场景的理解. 关于基准任务的广泛实验性评价,包括3D标题、问答和任务规划,始终表明3D-SceneQ相对于SOTA方法的优异表现。 这些成果突出了该框架在挑战3D环境中的可喜通用能力和增强的推理能力。 总体而言,3D-场景 Q代表了各种3D理解任务的显著进展,为未来与复杂3D环境的智能互动研究和应用奠定了坚实的基础.
